name: Will converting my garage affect my property value or taxes?

mainEntity.name: Will converting my garage affect my property value or taxes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Converting a garage into a guest suite can enhance functionality, beauty, and long-term value, as it adds usable, conditioned living space to your property. This type of customized renovation is often a desirable feature for potential buyers. However, any addition of conditioned square footage may lead to reassessment for property tax purposes. It's advisable to consult with a local tax professional to understand the potential impact specific to your property in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex.
acceptedAnswer.description: Converting a garage to a guest suite can increase property value by adding living space but may lead to property tax reassessment. Consult a tax professional for specifics.
